title: Mexicana Receives Its Ninth Embraer Aircraft; Increases Its Capacity by 11.04%
author: La Jornada Editorial Staff
content:
_This article originally appeared in the[September 20, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/09/20/politica/recibe-
mexicana-su-noveno-avion-embraer-incrementa-1104-su-capacidad), Mexico's
premier left-wing daily newspaper._

State-owned airline Mexicana received its ninth Embraer E2 aircraft,
registration XA-MXI, this weekend at the Felipe Ángeles International Airport
(AIFA), in Santa Lucía, State of Mexico. In a statement, the airline reported
that with this addition its fleet reaches a combined capacity of **57,020
seats per month** , representing an approximate increase of **11.04 percent**
in installed capacity compared to the eight aircraft previously incorporated.

"The growth of the fleet strengthens Mexicana's goal of 'connecting Mexico
with Mexico,' moving passengers and generating opportunities that contribute
to the development of the country's regions," it stated.

The Embraer 190-E2 aircraft, registration XA-MXI, has capacity for **108
passengers** and a 2+2 cabin configuration, with no middle seat. Like its
predecessors of this model, it incorporates cutting-edge technology that
improves fuel-consumption efficiency and reduces its emissions.
